Now I will teach you Silent Step.
Put foot down slow, like stalking deer. Feel ground first with toes, then heel. No sound, no rush. Body moves like shadow. Each step is soft, like falling leaf. This is Silent Step.

Try also: Light Foot, Still Stand, Hide in Dark.
